checks.name: asset-tier
checks.evidence: Tier C exact vector diagrams are the correct medium for a source-linked architecture story; homepage proof is real source, not illustration.

checks.name: export-inspection
checks.evidence: Twenty-one SVGs regenerated and XML parsed; 16:9, 4:5, and 1:1 rendered and inspected, including 360px social previews.

checks.name: visual-qa
checks.evidence: Independent design re-review scored 27/30 after status, loop, brand relation, typography, social legibility, and CTA fixes.

checks.name: responsive
checks.evidence: Production build checked at 1600x900 and 390x844 on five core routes; no horizontal overflow, one H1 and one main per page.

checks.name: accessibility
checks.evidence: SVG title/desc, semantic captions, keyboard-expandable mobile nav, 44px menu target, reduced-motion CSS, and sampled contrast above 5:1.

checks.name: privacy
checks.evidence: Notes API imports one explicit public record; unlisted slug returns 404; no private vault ingestion.

checks.name: motion
checks.evidence: No essential animation or generated motion is used in the seven chapters.

score.notes: Independent design review after one substantive and one social-legibility iteration.

known_risks: The new /proof route is preview-only until the web PR is deployed; source-controlled product social copy points to the live GitHub repository.
Capability statuses are pinned to the audited main commit and must be rechecked when the separate Foundry repair lands.
No real cross-venture outcome is yet measured; visual proof describes only local tools and staged work.
